name: Everstone Tales: The Special Candy
source:
‘Everstone Tales: The Special Candy’ is a short interactive story loosely set in the world of Pokemon! It features a primarily M/M-focused story that is intended for audiences ages 18 and above, and contains adult and kink (particularly ABDL) themed content. It is a spinoff of our other project, ‘Everstone Daycare’, and features the cast of that game as characters in this story.

Follow Weavile and Salandit, two members of Everstone Daycare’s “Retraining Program”, as they take part in some “special candy” that they had swiped from one of their nurse caretakers. Find out what’s so ‘special’ about the candy that it had to be locked away from them, and the kinky consequences that come from it!
translation:
《不变之石物语：特别糖果》是一部大致借用了《宝可梦》世界观的短篇互动故事！本作以男男（M/M）剧情为主，面向18岁及以上受众，包含成人及特殊癖好（尤其是ABDL恋尿布/幼化角色扮演）主题内容。本作是我们另一项目《不变之石培育屋》的衍生番外篇，原作中的角色们也将在本篇故事中登场。

追随“不变之石培育屋”再训练计划的两名成员——玛狃拉与夜盗火蜥，看他们偷偷顺走保育员护士珍藏的“特别糖果”分而食之！一探究竟这种不得不锁起来的糖果到底“特别”在何处，以及吞下它之后引发的一连串羞耻又刺激的后果吧！
